description_en: Removes one or more numbers from an instance. This action disassociates the numbers from the instance but does not permanently delete them. It also disassociates all associated resources, such as skill groups, contact flows, and agents
description_zh: 调用RemovePhoneNumbers删除指定实例下的一个或多个号码。并非真实删除某个号码，而是将这个号码与实例进行解绑，包括号码关联的技能组、联系流、坐席等，都将随之解绑
kebab_example: aliyun ccc remove-phone-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --number-list 01012340000_,_01056780000 --biz-force true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemovePhoneNumbers

parameters.description_en: The list of numbers to remove.
parameters.help_en: The list of numbers to remove
parameters.name: number_list

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to force the removal. If a number is associated with a skill group, contact flow, or agent, you must set this parameter to `true` to remove it. The default value is `false`.
parameters.description_zh: 是否强制删除，如果号码关联了技能组、联系流或坐席，只有将该字段设置为true才可以执行删除，非必填，默认false。
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force the removal. If a number is associated with a skill group, contact flow, or agent, you must set this parameter to `true` to remove it. The default value is `false`
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制删除，如果号码关联了技能组、联系流或坐席，只有将该字段设置为true才可以执行删除，非必填，默认false
parameters.name: force
